meta.title: flutter3d_matter solids: verified reference data (task 0.4)
meta.disclaimer: reference values for simulation, not for design or safety calculations
meta.layout: matter_data/SCHEMA.txt (the fluids layout): cas, groups{mechanical, thermal, acoustic, optical, electrical, inelastic, extra}; extra holds keys the catalog type lacks, named group.key; a temperature law sits on its value as "laws"; laws whose property has no value stay on the entry
meta.lawTemperature: laws give x and xUnit; the Eurocode laws keep theta in C (theta = T - 273.15) as the standards write them, all others are in K

schema.value: every property is {value, unit, source, sourceUrl?, confidence, verification, range?, note?, laws?}; value in SI; null = not found
schema.confidence: measured = a primary measurement on a named specimen; handbook = a compiled table or standard; estimate = derived, representative of a range, or assumed (always says how in the note)
schema.verification: fetched = the number was read from the cited source during this research; recalled = the cited handbook value as known to the researcher, not re-read here: open the source before 1.0; catalog = kept from the current materials.dart, whose source string the note quotes (not re-read here either)
schema.laws: temperature laws: kind table (points [T K, value]), polynomial / linear / exponential (form, coefficients), validRange in K
schema.catalogId: the existing f3d.* id when the material is already in the catalog
schema.groups: mechanical, thermal, acoustic, optical, electrical as in property_groups.dart; extra keys (shearModulus, compressiveStrength, linearExpansion, shearWaveSpeed, rodWaveSpeed, resistivityTempCoeff, dielectricF0) are new and named so; inelastic = damping, plastic, hyperelastic (proposed group of 3A)
schema.friction: the material against itself, dry, unless the note says otherwise; measured pairs are in pairs[]

units.johnsonCook: A, B in Pa; n, C, m no unit; meltTemperature, roomTemperature K; referenceStrainRate 1/s
units.ogden: mu_p in Pa, alpha_p no unit
